audit_notes: All 27 summary files, raw message/DB records, sampled backlog, window event rates, percentiles, scheduling lateness and resource summaries independently recomputed.
Body bytes were not retained; validity flags emitted by checksum-checking consumers were reconciled, rather than rehashing payload bytes offline.
CPU/memory/I/O summaries use first to last samples inside each measurement window; sampled memory maxima and 1-second backlog maxima can miss subinterval peaks.
PostgreSQL WAL LSN and database-size deltas include setup after readiness, warmup, measurement and drain, and stop before final container shutdown.
RabbitMQ message-store growth is not independently captured; PostgreSQL-size deltas are not total-stack persistent storage.
Workflow success is not provisional <=10% DB target success.
